_readme: THE FESTIVAL RUNS 2026-10-01 AND 10-02, and everything in this file is real
2026 data. 공연 has no place at all until the council sends one.
WHICH DAY A PLACE IS ON IS NOT WRITTEN HERE. The list's 1일차 / 2일차 tabs are
defined once, as absolute instants, in the layer set config
(src/map/config/eskara-2026.json, `facets` → `day`), and the server puts a
place in a day when one of its `hours` windows STARTS inside it. A pub open
both nights is in both tabs because it has two windows. A test fails on an
authored `facets.day` (and the server ignores one); only `tag` facets are
written here — today that is
`facets.org` on a 부스, `["council"]` (총학생회) or `["club"]` (학생단체).
A 부스 also carries `orderByOption` — `{"day1": 3, "day2": 11}` — because
the council orders booths separately for each day; `order` is still required
and is what every other list sorts by. 푸드트럭 sort by title (가나다), so their
`order` decides only a pin collision.
Until 2026-09-24 the app inferred the days from the dates in this file, so a
single stray date renumbered every place; the one mock booth (`daybooth-01`,
10/3) made every two-day place read 1·2일차 instead of 양일 for exactly that
reason. It was removed when the
days moved into the config. A test pins every window to a configured day.
THE FACILITY BLOCK IS REAL 2026 DATA. The nine 화장실 and the one 야간 자인
셔틀 대기 point were surveyed by the 총학생회 and handed over on 2026-09-19;
they are the only authored coordinates in this file. The placeholder toilets
they replaced sat on one interpolated line ~5 m apart, so every one of them was
wrong. Each new point was checked against the SKKU campus API (campusMap.do,
campusCd=2): the nearest building is the one the label names, 6-29 m away for
the seven that name a building.
The council handed over three shuttle queue points and corrected two of them
the same day: 제1과학관 and 제2과학관 are 화장실, not queue points, and only
복지회관 앞 is a queue. Nothing moved — toilet-sci1 and toilet-sci2 carry the
surveyed coordinates unchanged; what changed is what they are.
The shuttle queue point carries `hours: []` because the council sent a POSITION
ONLY. It is night-only in reality, so that empty list is the one place this
file stretches the rule below — fill `hours` the moment the night shuttle
timetable is confirmed.
ONE ENTRY PER PLACE. A booth open on both festival days is one entry with two
windows in `hours` — never two entries. The previous format had a `days: [1,2]`
key that the importer expanded into `-d1` and `-d2` documents, which is what
made the app list every place twice; the reader now REJECTS that key by name.
No id encodes a festival day. The night bars were `nightbar-d1-02` and
`nightbar-d2-03` — two different tenants on one plot, on different nights —
and a day in the id is now redundant with `hours` and reads like the split
that caused the bug. A test rejects `-d<n>` anywhere in an id.
`hours` is a list of absolute intervals, both bounds required. An empty list
means always open (화장실, 의무실, 배리어프리존) and means only that. A window
crossing midnight is written with the next day's date. (The 2025 주점 ran to
00:00 and were written that way; the 2026 pubs close at 23:00.)
`lat`/`lng` are named here and become GeoJSON [lng, lat] in the reader — one
conversion site on the write path, mirroring the projection on the read path
(umbrella ADR 0004 invariant 3).
Two places may share a coordinate only when their windows are disjoint — plots
1, 2, 3~4 and 5 hold a different pub each night — and a test enforces exactly
that.
THE TWO CONTROL ZONES ARE REAL 2026 DATA, and the first `geometry` entries in
this file. The 총학생회 handed over 13 points for 진입 통제구역 and 4 for 차량
통제구역 on 2026-09-20, with one instruction: connect each zone's points in the
order given. Both are closed rings — the 진입 ring's first and last points sit
14 m apart and the 차량 ring's 175 m, so neither arrived closed and both are
closed here by repeating the first position. Neither ring self-intersects.
They are thin corridors along campus roads, not areas enclosing booths:
exactly ONE existing place falls inside 진입 통제구역 and none inside 차량
통제구역, which is why they are left tappable instead of made backdrops — a
zone that swallows no taps may as well carry the sheet that explains it.
The council also sent one rule with NO coordinates — 기숙사 사생 외 모든 인원의
기숙사 전관 출입 금지. It rides 진입 통제구역's `fields`, because a tappable
zone's sheet is the only place on this map that can carry a sentence. Move it
the moment there is a better home for it.
THE THREE 팔찌 배부 부스 ARE REAL 2026 DATA, handed over by the 총학생회 on
2026-09-20. Each coordinate was checked against the SKKU campus API
(campusMap.do, campusCd=2) the way the facility block was: the nearest
building is the one the council named — 글로벌광장 33 m, 삼성학술정보관 37 m,
글로벌광장 50 m. The three sit 28-38 m apart, so they are three places rather
than one, and the nearest other place is 99 m away.
THE END IS UNANNOUNCED, AND NOTHING IS STORED FOR IT. The council sent
opening times only (12:00~, 14:00~, 17:00~): distribution closes when the
artist stage does, and the council announces it on its Instagram story. Each
window has a startAt and no endAt, which the sheet prints as `14:00~`
(2026-09-26, council's request). Until then a 22:00 ceiling was stored
because a window could not be open-ended; it read as a confirmed time and the
council asked for it gone. The layer set's activation is what takes the
booths off the map after the festival. Each sheet still carries a 운영 안내
`notice` saying the close is posted on Instagram — the sentence that the end
varies was dropped at the council's request. `kind: etc` rather than
`facility`, so a kind filter on 편의시설 never picks the booths up.
Distribution is 2일차 (10. 2.) ONLY — these booths do not run on 1일차 at
all, and they only hand out wristbands. 짐 검사 is a separate booth at the
대운동장 entrance gate, on both days (council, 2026-09-24). The 성균인 booth
has two LABELLED windows, 단체 입장 12:00-14:00 then 개별 입장 14:00~, because
a bare 12:00~ read as if 개별 입장 started at 12:00 too (council,
2026-09-26). They are contiguous, and the client's status line runs them
together, so at 13:00 it says 운영 중 rather than ending at 14:00.
Its 팔찌 배부 안내 button is a `miniapp` action (`eskara-2026/eskara/wristband`),
so the page opens inside the ESKARA mini app rather than the generic web view.
The council wrote that a 티켓 부스 already existed here under another name.
It did not — 팔찌/티켓/매표/발권 matched nothing in this repository. What they
saw was almost certainly the 부스 chip's 🎫, which now belongs to 입장 instead.
That chip is 입장 팔찌 배부 since 2026-09-24, the name the council chose; 부스
took 🎪.
차량 통제구역 WAS RESURVEYED on 2026-09-22. Three corners moved 1.2-1.7 m and
the east end moved 6.9 m, which squared the strip off: its two short edges
were 22.3 m and 15.5 m and are now 21.6 m and 21.7 m. Area 3,257 -> 3,812 m2,
still a simple closed ring. The same edit split the two zones onto their own
layers so they could take the colours the council asked for — 진입 red, 차량
blue — and turned both off by default, to be seen only when the 통제구역 chip
is tapped.
EACH ZONE CARRIES ITS NAME AS A SECOND, POINT-SHAPED PLACE. A polygon overlay
has no caption, so `control-entry-label` and `control-vehicle-label` are bare
captions (their layers are `markerStyle: textLabel`) standing on the zone's
OWN layer — which is the whole trick: the layer is what a toggle or a chip
switches, so the name comes and goes with the zone and nothing links them.
They take their own `*_label` categories so a word's tappability is decided
apart from its zone's — today neither takes a tap (see below).
The 진입 label is NOT at the zone's centroid, because that centroid falls
OUTSIDE the zone — the ring is a U-shaped band. It sits at the interior point
farthest from every edge, the southern lobe, about 81 m wide there. The 차량
strip is convex, so its label is simply the centroid. Move either one with
the ring it names.
2026-09-22: EVERY 통제구역 PLACE IS INERT — both zones and both words are
`interactive: false`. That REVERSES the reasoning in the 2026-09-20
paragraph above, which left the zones tappable so a sheet could carry the
기숙사 line: the council wants the whole area read, not opened. The cost is
stated rather than hidden. The 기숙사 sentence is now the entry zone's
`subtitle`, and a subtitle reaches a screen only through the place's sheet —
so on the map it is reachable through the event list's row alone, and not
at all once that list shows only tappable places.
THE 17 FOOD TRUCKS ARE REAL 2026 DATA, handed over by the 총학생회 on
2026-09-22 as a vendor list (업체명 and one 메뉴/가격 cell each) and 48 menu
photos from the vendor's agency (뉴플레이스컴퍼니). Each truck carries a
`detail`: its menu as a table, split by hand from the free-text cell with every
price kept exactly as written, then one image block per photo. The photos
live on media.skkuverse.com (R2), cropped of the template's white band and
drop shadow and re-encoded at a 1280 px long edge; each key carries a hash of
its content, so a replaced photo is a new URL and never an overwrite.
Ids are VENDOR slugs (`truck-oyabong`), not plot numbers, and they stay as
they are when a name is corrected: the R2 photo keys embed them.
CONFIRMED BY THE 총학생회 ON 2026-09-24. Names are the photo folders' spellings,
not the list's: 팬팬마라, 오야붕, 써니플, 피꼬브로 (the list said 판판마라,
오야봉, 써니쿡, 피꼬보로). Every truck runs 11:00-23:00 on both days, except
다모아푸드 (10/1 only) and 팬팬마라 (10/2 only) — the values already here.
THE TRUCKS HAVE NO PLOTS. Each truck's spot is decided on the day, somewhere
along 신관A 앞길, and the council sent one point for the whole area. That
point lies inside the 차량 통제구역 ring, 61 m from its west end on the 신관
side. The 2025 page put the trucks on "후문 - 신관 사이 도로", drawn as one
row along a road that matches this one (inferred from the drawing, not
confirmed), and 17 trucks in a row need about 150 m of its 176.
So the area is drawn with that ring, reused verbatim, as `food-zone`, on
the food layer, visible the way the 통제구역 are.
ONE PIN STANDS FOR ALL 17. `food-zone-pin` and every truck share the
council's point, verbatim. The app draws one pin per coordinate, and the
zone pin always wins it: its `pinPriority` (25) beats a truck's (20) and its
windows cover every truck's, so it is never the closed one. The map therefore
says "푸드트럭", never one vendor's name on a spot that vendor may not
have. The trucks lose the pin but keep their list rows — the 푸드트럭 chip's
list — and a truck chosen there is drawn on the spot and opens its own sheet.
This is the one sanctioned stack; the clash test allows a group on one
coordinate only under such a head.
THE AREA IS A WAY INTO THAT LIST, NOT A PLACE. Both `food_zone` and
`food_zone_pin` carry `tapChip: eskara26_view_food` in the layer set config,
so tapping the ring or the pin does what the 푸드트럭 chip does — its layers,
camera and list — and neither has a sheet (2026-09-24: the zone's own sheet,
a notice and a 17-row list, was dropped for this). An app build older than
the `chip` tap kind draws both inert.
The `food` category is `locationAccuracy: area` in the layer set config: a
truck's pin names the area, not its spot, so the app opens a truck's sheet
tall rather than low beside a map that would point at nothing.
Still not given: the council's Instagram post link. 우마이식당's salmon photo
is filed as 크림연어초밥 but the list sells 생연어초밥 — captioned per the list.
제이푸드's 크레페메뉴판 photo is NOT published: it is a 4-item "BEST Pick!"
board whose 바나나 + 누텔라 크레페 (6,000원) the list does not sell.
THE 18 NIGHT PUBS ARE REAL 2026 DATA, handed over by the 총학생회 on
2026-09-23 as a sheet (운영 일시, 주점 위치, 주점명, 단체명, 대표 메뉴 1-3,
링크), 16 plot coordinates, and a plot drawing. They replace all 18 of the
2025 `bar-*` and `nightbar-*` entries. Ids are TENANT slugs
(`bar-chamgyoyuk`), never plot numbers: a plot changes hands between nights.
All run 18:00-23:00. Six are 10/1 only, six 10/2 only, six (the 양 plots —
양일) both days, so each carries one or two windows and the app derives its
1일차 / 2일차 / 양일 label from them. Plots 1, 2, 3~4 and 5 hold a different
pub each night on ONE coordinate; their windows are disjoint, which is the
one way the clash test allows two places on a point. A pub on two plots
(3~4, 7~8, 6~7, 양5~6, 양7~8) stands at the midpoint of the two.
The drawing is rotated: its top is EAST and its right is SOUTH. Fitted onto
the coordinates, all 16 plots agree with it to within 10 m.
PLOT 1 WAS CORRECTED BY THE COUNCIL ON 2026-09-24. Their first point had been
mixed up with another location: it equalled `toilet-bar` to 0.04 m and sat
112 m from plot 2, where the drawing puts plot 1 beside plot 2. The app keys
pins at six decimals, so on those nights the pub pin hid the toilet's. The
corrected point (moved for both plot-1 pubs, `bar-72min-sogaeting` and
`bar-gonggyeong-rodang`) is 2.5 m from where the drawing fit put it and 25 m
from plot 2. The clash test now keys at six decimals, as the app does, so
that collision cannot come back unnoticed. The council's coordinates are
stored at FULL precision, as sent, unlike the rest of the file.
Each pub carries a `detail`: kind `pub`, the 단체명 as `org` (also the
`subtitle`, which is the line the event list shows — the sheet shows `org`
in its place), `isUnion` when the 단체명 joins two groups with X, a
`N번 주점` location label, one Instagram action, and the three 대표 메뉴 as a
list. A trailing parenthetical in a menu cell is its description; every
other word is as written. The council gave no emoji; each menu's emoji was
picked for the dish itself (not the pun in its name), and every one is
checked to have a glyph in the app's bundled TossFaceFontMac.ttf, which is
the font the menu list draws its emoji in. Without one the app falls back
to a ✨ for every item. The council reviewed these on 2026-09-24 and asked
to keep them as they are.
Instagram links are cut to `https://www.instagram.com/<handle>/`. The sheet's
links carried share tokens (`stkn=`), `utm_*` tags and trailing spaces, and a
trailing space fails the importer. 공경로당 (공과대학 X 경영대학) was sent
with 酒情뱅이's link, `skku_science` (자연과학대학's account); the council
corrected it to `skku.eng_official` on 2026-09-24.
Line breaks inside the name cells are single spaces. The two 🕸 around
스 PHA×의 더맨 are dropped because plain app text draws emoji as boxes;
♡, ビ and the hanja are kept.
Each pub's poster is an image block (`poster`) after its menu. The 총학생회
sent the 18 posters on 2026-09-25 (26eskara/야간주점/스꾸버스_주점 포스터/,
one folder per day, named <plot>_<pub>); they were matched to places by plot
and day, never by name. They were re-encoded as JPEG at a 1600 px long edge
(never upscaled) — larger than the trucks' 1280 because a poster is mostly
small text — with transparent PNGs flattened onto white. Keys follow the
trucks': eskara-2026/pubs/<id>/01-<sha256[:8]>.jpg, never overwritten.
THE 21 DAYTIME BOOTHS ARE REAL 2026 DATA, handed over by the 총학생회 on
2026-09-25 as a sheet (운영 일시, 위치, 부스명, 단체명, 단체 설명, 대표
콘텐츠), a plot drawing per day, and one coordinate per plot per day
(26eskara/부스/). They follow the pubs: one sheet row is one place, ids are
TENANT slugs, and a plot that changes hands between days holds two places.
Nine run 10/1 and eight 10/2, 12:00-16:00, one window each. 리플렛(도장판)
배부 is plot 1 on both days but runs a different event each day, so it is
two places on one point (`booth-leaflet-stamp`, `booth-leaflet-pass`), the
way pub plots 1, 2, 3~4 and 5 are. The four goods booths A-D are the same
booths both days, so each is one place with two windows — 10/1 11:00-16:00
and 10/2 14:00-19:00 — and `detail.kind: goods`. The sheet gave them no
content.
THE GOODS SHOP'S PRICES AND PHOTOS arrived on 2026-09-26: nine items with a
price and a spec line, and one image each. They sit on C only
(`goods-uniform-store`, ESKARA: 초록의 파도 유니폼 & 굿즈 스토어) by decision,
because that is the booth named for them. A, B and D keep no body. C is
built like a truck: a `table` (`menu`, label = item, value = price as sent),
then one `image` per item in the same order, captioned with the item and
its spec (`55*55(cm)` written 55×55cm). The files were matched to items by
what each shows, not by number — 003 is 원피스, 004 크롭, 005 농구. Each was
cropped to its mint card, flattened onto white and re-encoded as JPEG at a
1280 px long edge; keys are
eskara-2026/goods/goods-uniform-store/<nn>-<sha256[:8]>.jpg, never
overwritten. The council has NOT sent running hours yet, so A-D's hours
above are still provisional. The 부스 layer still
shows itself 11:00-18:00 and hands over to 주점 at 18:00: goods on 10/2
18:00-19:00 stay one 부스 chip away, which is what the layer window is for
(docs/reference/map-overlays-api.md, "How to author the schedules").
Coordinates are the council's, stored at FULL precision as sent. Six 10/1
plots are 10/2 plots too, and two are pub plots: 10/1 plot 1 is pub plot 6
(`bar-harry-potter`) and 10/1 plot 8 / 10/2 plot 6 is pub plot 8
(`bar-seonggyun-theater`). Every window sharing a point is disjoint — booths
close at 16:00, pubs open at 18:00 — so the clash test passes. No goods
point is a pub point, which matters because goods run to 19:00 on 10/2.
Two more booth points sit about 0.2 m from a pub — 10/1 plot 3 / 10/2 plot 2
from `bar-jujeongbaengi`, 10/1 plot 7 / 10/2 plot 4 from `bar-yes-some-noise`
— without sharing a six-decimal key, so the app draws two pins there. They
are kept as sent: those two pub points are OUR midpoints of two plots, the
booth points the council's own, and the 부스 and 주점 layers are never
shown together by default.
`facets.org` is `council` for 총학생회 S'PEAK and `club` for 킹고응원단, 알리미,
FG, 에스엔젤 and 청랑. `orderByOption` is the sheet's plot number on each
day the booth runs; A-D follow the numbered plots (10/1 10-13, 10/2 9-12).
Each booth's `detail` is shaped like a pub's: the 단체명 as `org` and
`subtitle`, an `N번 부스` location label, and the 대표 콘텐츠 as a `list`
block — one item per activity, so one for most booths and three for FG,
에스엔젤 and 청랑. An item's title is the activity's own name where the sheet
gives one (알을 깨고 나와라!) and a short summary otherwise (이색 신발
레이스); its description is the sheet's text for it, whitespace aside. The
council gave no emoji; each item's was picked for the activity and checked
for a glyph in TossFaceFontMac.ttf, as the pub menus were. A 단체 설명 other
than `-` or blank becomes a `text` block (`intro`, 단체 소개) ahead of the list, and
FG's one-line story a `story` block. No booth has an Instagram link, and
no numbered booth has a poster: the council confirmed on 2026-09-25 that
none exists for either day and that this line-up is final.
The emoji inside names (😽 🦀 🐼 🐉) and in 청랑's descriptions (🐬 🎣 🐟)
are dropped, as the pubs' 🕸 were: titles and descriptions are plain app
text, not the Tossface tiles. ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ and ♥ are kept. Without its 🐉,
킹고응원단's 용🐉 감하게 would read as a broken word, so it is written
용감하게 — the one name changed beyond dropping an emoji.

items.title: 도장판 이벤트 응모
items.description: 도장판을 모두 채우고 이벤트에 응모해 보세요! 추첨을 통해 10만 원권 / 7만 원권 / 3만 원권 상품을 드립니다.

items.title: 운명 매칭
items.description: 포스트잇 속 설명에 맞는 사람을 찾아 인연을 연결해보는 운명 매칭 부스 새로운 인연의 조건을 적어 박스에 넣고, 함께 운명을 완성해보세요!

items.title: 이색 신발 레이스
items.description: 룰렛을 돌려 5종의 이색 신발 중 하나를 랜덤으로 뽑고, 선택된 신발을 신고 달리는 이색 레이스!

items.title: 13.98초 맞히기
items.description: 눈을 감고 13.98초를 맞춰라! 오차범위 0.5초 내 시간 측정 슬랩버튼 게임에 도전해보세요.

blocks.title: 단체 소개
blocks.body: 성균의 이름으로 하나 되어, 뜨거운 응원으로 성균인들의 청춘을 빛내는 성균관대학교 킹고응원단입니다.

items.title: 응원법 챌린지
items.description: 참여자는 도전할 응원가 난이도를 선택하고 시범 영상을 시청한 후, 응원가에 맞춰 응원 구호를 정확한 타이밍에 외치면 성공!

blocks.title: 단체 소개
blocks.body: 최고의 대학에서 만나는 최고의 인연! 성균관대학교 입학처 산하 공식 홍보대사 학생단체 알리미입니다.

items.title: 워리스톤 만들기
items.description:
알곰이의 곰인형과 ‘고민’형 언어유희를 활용한 부스
학우들의 소소한 고민(전공, 연애, 진로, 학교생활 등)을 해소할 워리스톤의 제작 체험을 할 수 있는 체험형 부스.

blocks.title: 단체 소개
blocks.body: FG는 대계열제 신입생들의 원활한 학교 생활을 지원하는 단체입니다.

blocks.title: 부스 스토리
blocks.body: 병아리 같은 새내기가 알을 깨고 나와 성장하는 스토리.

items.title: 알을 깨고 나와라!
items.description: 두 손가락만을 이용해 13.98초 내에 111번 터치하면 성공!

items.title: 병아리는 삐약삐약
items.description: 특정 동물의 울음소리를 듣고 어떤 동물인지 정답을 맞힙니다. 총 3문제 중 2문제 이상을 맞히면 성공!

items.title: 날아올라! 병아리!
items.description: 종이비행기를 날려 일정 거리 이상 성공하면 성공!

blocks.title: 단체 소개
blocks.body: 성균관대학교 공식 학교발전 홍보대사로, 재학생과 동문 선배님을 잇는 가교 역할을 하고 있습니다.

items.title: 성균관에 마음을 쏙!
items.description: 1분동안 탁구공을 테이블에 한 번 튀겨 컵에 넣는 게임입니다. 공은 ‘학교를 사랑하는 마음’, 컵은 ‘성균관’을 상징하며, 학교에 마음을 전한다는 의미를 담았습니다.

items.title: 엔젤들의 이심전심
items.description: 참여자의 구호에 맞춰 세 명의 엔젤이 각자 고른 인형을 동시에 공개하고, 모두 같은 인형이면 성공하는 인간 슬롯머신 게임입니다.

items.title: 학교를 찾아라!
items.description: 성균관대학교 캠퍼스 사진의 일부를 보고 해당 장소를 맞히는 퀴즈입니다. 익숙한 캠퍼스를 새롭게 바라보고, 잘 몰랐던 공간을 알아가며 학교에 대한 관심을 높이는 활동입니다.

blocks.title: 단체 소개
blocks.body: 성균관의 역사와 전통을 재현하는 유생문화기획단 청랑

items.title: 삑삐빅삐-익
items.description: 소리를 잘 듣고 돌랑이가 명륜당에 오게 된 이유를 알아내라!

items.title: 돌랑이 구출 대작전!
items.description: 돌랑이가 바다로 돌아갈 수 있도록 힘을 합쳐 구출해보자! 다른 해양 동물들에게 낚이지 말고 낚싯대를 이용해 돌랑이를 정확히 찾아라!

items.title: 마님은 왜 돌고래에게 물고기를 줬을까?
items.description: 돌고래를 구출했으니 이제 바다로 돌려보내야 하는데… 잠깐, 배가 고프다고? 집 가기도 식후경! 의지의 한국인답게 돌고래에게 맛있는 물고기를 먹여주자

items.title: PASS 모아 응모
items.description: 부스를 돌며 5개 이상의 과목에서 PASS를 획득하면 응모 부스에서 상품 추첨에 응모할 수 있습니다.

items.title: 에어건 사격
items.description: 탕! 탕! 탕! 에어건으로 세계 지도 속 목표 시장을 저격해 보세요.

items.title: 코끼리 코 돌고 중심 잡기
items.description: 이 정도 포즈는 쉽게 따라할 수 있겠죠?! 코끼리 코를 돈 뒤 중심을 잡아보세요.

items.title: 합이 10인 사과 찾기
items.description: 누구보다 빠르게 합이 10이 되는 사과를 찾아보세요.

items.title: 철권 대결
items.description: 나비처럼 날아서 벌처럼 쏜다! 철권 게임에서 승리를 쟁취해 보세요.

items.title: 심리전 잭팟
items.description: 운이 아니라 실력이야~ 상대방의 심리를 읽고 잭팟을 터뜨려 보세요!

items.title: 망치질 실력 뽐내기
items.description: 뚝 딱 뚝 딱~! 숨겨진 망치질 실력을 뽐내 보세요.

items.title: 영어 단어 찾기
items.description: 꼬깔을 쓰고 좁아진 시야 속에서 올바른 영어 단어를 찾아보세요!
